title: Why you tidy your desk instead of the hard task

scenes.say: You organized everything except the task.
A report is due. Suddenly the desk needs tidying, the inbox needs sorting, and the pens need lining up.
One explanation: the hard task brings boredom or self-doubt. Tidying makes that feeling fade, so it feels like progress.
A classic study tracked students across a term. Procrastinators felt less stressed early on, then more stressed and sicker later, with lower grades.
Researchers describe it as choosing your mood now over your future self. The relief is real. It just doesn't last.
